account: The project uses data science and AI to examine the procedures for determining refugee status. In its June 2025 account, UNHCR names faster administration and earlier access to rights and services as intended benefits. UNHCR expects pilot deployments in a later phase. On 8 August 2025 Anadolu Agency reported that the project was in its early stages and worked on historical anonymized case data. Adriana Rojas Arnaud of UNHCR told the agency that UNHCR had begun to see early results, but she gave no figures. UNHCR planned to work with live data and to build a business intelligence tool for managers. No source documents a reduction in processing time or an outcome for any applicant's legal status.
